knownLimitations.PV-NODE-UNPINNED: No Node version is pinned in either package and the Render runtime version could not be read. A rebuild reproduces the source digest but not, provably, the artifact.
knownLimitations.OPS-DB-PROVIDER-MISSTATED: Two operations documents name Render as the database platform; production is Neon. An operator following deployment-runbook step 3 would look for a Render Postgres instance that does not exist.
knownLimitations.DB-4-OUTCOMES-TABLE-PRESENT: RESOLVED at §291. The recurrence query is workspace-scoped and proven on a production-shaped database with a negative control. The table remains outside the migration lineage; adopting it is a registered product-owner decision.
knownLimitations.EXPERT-DISABLED: EXPERT_EXECUTION_ENABLED=false in production. Live provider transport has never been exercised; hazlenz:verify reports UNVERIFIED_LIVE for provider transport.
knownLimitations.STORAGE-REPORT-ROUNDTRIP-NOT-DONE: CLOSED at §290. A generated report round-tripped through production storage from the deployed candidate with the R2 bytes, the database record and the served bytes all hashing to 59ce3cd1…, and an unsigned read of that object refused HTTP 400.
knownLimitations.NO-MONITORING-AGGREGATION: The alerting mechanism exists and is proven (error-severity events dispatched, 5xx burst raises one rate event, de-duplicated, 401/402/404/400/409 never alert). NO DESTINATION IS CONFIGURED IN PRODUCTION, and /health/ready reports alerting: NOT_CONFIGURED so this is visible rather than assumed. MO-1 remains open on one configuration step.
knownLimitations.NEON-RETENTION-UNREAD: Neon's control plane was not reachable from this session (no NEON_* credential). The platform backup retention window and point-in-time-recovery setting are UNREAD. The operator-controlled logical backup path is proven independently.
knownLimitations.LEGAL-NOT-CLEARED: Terms, Privacy Notice, third-party model disclosure, contracting entity and trademark clearance are all open at Threshold C. Nothing here asserts legal clearance.
knownLimitations.NO-EXTERNAL-BETA: External beta remains BLOCKED regardless of Threshold A status.
knownLimitations.BR-3-CLOSED: Closed at §290. check:launch-pricing no longer conflates the retired Expert pricing tier with Expert HazLenz the capability; 49 passed, 0 failed.
knownLimitations.INDEXING-WITHHELD: Production serves X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow on every route until External Beta is authorised. NEXT_PUBLIC_ALLOW_INDEXING=true lifts it.
knownLimitations.SYNTHETIC-RELEASE-RESIDUE: §290 left two synthetic accounts on @release-test.invalid, one site/inspection/observation/finding, and one report revision with its PDF in R2. The entitlement grant was revoked. The report was deliberately NOT deleted because report immutability (RR-2) is the guarantee §290 verified, and deleting the R2 object alone would orphan its storage_objects row.
knownLimitations.PRODUCTION-SCHEMA-DIVERGENCE: Migration replay does NOT reproduce production. Production has 77 tables; a clean replay of all 55 migrations produces 56. Twenty-one entity-derived tables predate the lineage, created by TypeORM synchronize before that switch was turned off. See PRODUCTION-SCHEMA-PROVENANCE.md. A rebuild following this guide will produce a SMALLER schema than production, and `outcomes` in particular must be created for the corrective-action closure path to function.
knownLimitations.EM-2-NO-RESEND-CREDENTIAL: PASSWORD_RESET_PROVIDER=resend but RESEND_API_KEY and PASSWORD_RESET_FROM_EMAIL are absent from production, so password reset cannot deliver and the email alerting channel is unavailable.
